hosts.description: List of dynamic DNS host entries to update. Each entry defines the domain, login credentials, and optionally overrides for server/protocol.

domain.description: The fully qualified domain name (FQDN) to update (e.g., 'example.com' or 'sub.example.com').

login.description: Username or API key used for authentication with the DNS provider.

password.description: Password or secret used for authentication. Avoid plaintext in production; use a secure secrets manager if possible.

log_file.description: Optional absolute path to a log file (e.g., '/var/log/ddclient.log'). If empty, logging goes to syslog only.
